About

A steady hand on your biggest day

Deepika Brown Makeovers is a bridal and party makeup studio in Ernakulam, Kerala. Every girl deserves to feel like her best self on the days that matter — weddings, receptions, and celebrations — and that takes a makeover artist who understands both the occasion and the skin underneath the look.

Clients come back for makeup that photographs beautifully and holds up through hours of ceremony, dancing, and heat — without cracking, fading, or turning oily by evening.

Services

What we do

Bridal Makeup

Full bridal looks built to last through the entire ceremony, with skin-first prep and long-wear finishing.

Party & Occasion Makeup

Reception, engagement, and event-ready looks tailored to your outfit and the evening's lighting.

Nail Art

Manicures and nail finishes to match the occasion, from soft classics to statement glitter.
